rules.accepted_credit_types: All ACPE-accredited activities; other activities approved by the Board (CPE Committee); accredited college post-graduate courses; CPE granted credit by other states
rules.alternatives: Waiver on request for illness, injury, incapacity, retirement or other extenuating circumstances; graduate students/residents in health-related programs need no further CPE documentation. Non-residents not practicing in WV may certify a valid home-state license.
rules.audit_note: Keep CPE records 4 years (may be kept in CPE Monitor) and submit on Board request.

topics.who: Within one year of initial licensure: drug diversion, best-practice prescribing of controlled substances and opioid antagonist training (Board-approved; counts toward the 30)

rules.notes: Two-year reporting period July 1 – June 30. 6 of the 30 hours must be live with direct presence. Hours include CPE for consultant and immunization registrations. A list of completed CPE is submitted on Board forms with the renewal.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. §15-3 (Continuing Education for Licensure of Pharmacists), effective May 3, 2024
